death.note: Placed by her sons, which is the whole of her page: "the holy Theodote was the mother of the Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian... and she departed this life in peace". `cosmas-of-asia` and `damian-of-asia` both carry a death of the 3rd–4th century, two readings their page gives without choosing between them, and this folder can be no narrower than theirs.
